caption: The drawing depicts a single jug or pitcher with a handle and a metal lid. The body of the jug is made of glass and features a swirling pattern of alternating red and white stripes that run diagonally from the top to the bottom, curving around the form. The bottom half of the jug is more rounded and bulbous, with the swirling pattern forming a raised, textured surface. The handle is clear and attached to the upper side of the jug. The lid and spout are rendered in metallic gray, with a domed top and a small finial at the peak, as well as a protruding thumb lever on one side. The object is centered against a plain, beige background, and the drawing has a realistic style with attention to details of color, shading, and reflections. There is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "Hugh Clarke."
title: Molasses or Syrup Mug
